newsitem.title: CHINA: China '97 motor vehicle supply to outstrip demand.
newsitem.headline: China '97 motor vehicle supply to outstrip demand.

text.p: China's motor vehicle supply is expected to outstrip demand by about 340,000 units in 1997, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
China will need 1.66 million motor vehicles in 1997, up eight percent from 1996, the newspaper said, quoting Zhang Lianyou, general manager of the China Automotive Trade Corp.

Motor vehicle supply is expected to total two million units in 1997 -- 1.65 million newly produced units, 100,000-120,000 imported vehicles and a stockpile of 250,000 from last year, the newspaper said.
China is expected to build 1.55 million motor vehicles and import 80,000 units in 1996, the weekly said. It gave no further details.
